answer: The 3-month reduced payment programme (HP-LOAN-RED3) lasts 3 months. During that time the customer pays 50% of their regular payment, so the payment is cut in half. Interest keeps building up, and the unpaid amount is added to the end of the loan term. The programme is open to accounts up to 90 days past due. Two other sources give different figures, but the current policy wins: the FAQ (Q1) says 6 months, and the outdated v4.1 policy said a 40% reduction for 2 months.
